meaning: A screen setting that swaps bright white backgrounds for dark ones. It can be easier on your eyes in a dim room.
clues: It changes the colors of your screen.
Menus and apps turn dark with light words, but photos and videos keep their normal colors.
It can be easier on your eyes in a dim room.
You can set it to turn on by itself at sunset.
It has two words. The first is the opposite of light.
assumes: Night Shift makes screen colors warmer at night
Screen brightness is how bright the screen looks
Color inversion flips every color on the screen

decoys.meaning: An iPhone setting that makes screen colors warmer so they are easier on your eyes at night.
How bright the screen looks, from dim to bright.
A setting that flips every color on the screen, so photos look like film negatives.

exchange.text: I am already a little gray, so dark mode suits me just fine.

exchange.text: Tip: try the automatic setting so it switches on at sunset. Your eyes will thank you.
